Adventurer Rosanna is a guest of Fraygo's Flophouse in Wyrm's Crossing during Act Three.
“
'Come to Baldur's Gate', he said. 'Adventurers get welcomed as heroes', he said. Poxy Drim and his bleedin' notions.
„
— Rosanna

Involvement

Act Three

Rosanna set out for Baldur's Gate as an adventurer despite her father's resistance. Although she initially disagreed with his suggestion to become a tanner, she feels regret and impatience as she and  Drim await entry into the city.
